annotations.title: Open pension funds (OFE) and the ZUS subaccount (KNF, ZUS)

description: Use for open pension funds (OFE) in Poland: members, net assets, accounting unit value by fund, OFE rates of return over 1, 3, 5 and 10 years, and how 100 PLN in OFE compares with the ZUS subaccount. For IKE and IKZE, use get_ike_ikze_stats. For a pension forecast, use get_pension_forecast. Polish open pension funds (OFE) from KNF. topic market: latest month (members, net assets, weighted average accounting unit value, contributions from ZUS) with the previous month and a year earlier, and each fund (unit value, change in 12 months, share of net assets). topic returns: net rates of return over 12, 36, 60 and 120 months by fund and weighted average (KNF, April and October) and 100 PLN in OFE vs 100 PLN on the ZUS subaccount over the same window (yearly subaccount indexation from 1 June), with Różnica OFE i subkonta ZUS finwire (finwire_ofe_vs_subaccount_10y, pp). Default all topics. Past results, no forecasts, not investment advice.

fund.description: Optional fund id or part of the name (e.g. "pzu", "nationale-nederlanden") for the 100 PLN comparison; default weighted average of all OFE.
